_meta.notes: Key: UAB Presidential auto tier $22,500/yr OOS at 3.5-3.99 GPA + 1420-1600 SAT — HE QUALIFIES at 3.67/1440; Alabama Presidential $28k/yr auto at 3.5+ GPA + 1420-1600 SAT — HE QUALIFIES (1440 in band; earlier belief he was 10 pts short was wrong — tier starts 1420); UAB EMSAP early assurance restricted to AL+contiguous states; Rice/Baylor = 6 seats; Tulane Creative Premedical Scholars = early assurance into Tulane med, no MCAT, apply sophomore year, 3.6+ college GPA, Liberal Arts BA students; Ohio State National Buckeye up to $13.5k auto-considered; CU Boulder Presidential $15k competitive.

merit.note: ~20% of admits get merit, no tiers

rice.premed: no own med school; Rice/Baylor Medical Scholars = 6 seats/yr guaranteed BCM

merit.note: auto-considered partial merit up to $32k/yr; full-tuition Dean's needs ~1500/3.7+

tulane.premed: own School of Medicine; Creative Premedical Scholars EAP: guaranteed Tulane med seat, NO MCAT, apply spring sophomore yr, 3.6+ GPA, School of Liberal Arts BA students
tulane.deadlines: ED1 Nov 1 / EA Nov 10 / RD Jan 15

merit.name: Presidential (AUTO tier: 3.5-3.99 GPA + 1420-1600 SAT, OOS) — qualifies

uab.premed: UAB Heersink SOM + academic medical center ON campus; EMSAP early assurance = AL + contiguous states only (restricted for CA)
uab.deadlines: rolling; OOS scholarship apply by May 1

merit.name: UA Presidential (AUTO tier: 3.5+ GPA + 1420-1600 SAT, OOS) — qualifies; GPA counted through junior year

bama.premed: no MD school on Tuscaloosa campus (CCHS = regional Heersink campus for clinical yrs)

merit.name: National Buckeye up to $13.5k/yr + Maximus/Provost/Trustees $1-3k, auto-considered w/ Nov 1 EA, competitive

ohst.premed: own College of Medicine + Wexner Medical Center; NO undergrad early assurance
ohst.deadlines: EA Nov 1 (required for merit/honors) / RD Jan 15

cub.premed: no med school in Boulder (CU SOM is at Anschutz, Aurora); no early assurance
cub.deadlines: EA Nov 15 / RD Jan 15 (apply by Jan 15 for scholarships)
